query_normalized: predicting adsorption isotherm parameters from molecular features chemistry
rationale: The paper concerns estimating Freundlich adsorption isotherm parameters and their uncertainty — the same dependent variable (isotherm parameters) in the user's domain (adsorption chemistry), satisfying criterion (b)/(a). It is canonical prior work on how isotherm parameters are estimated and their accuracy characterized, which a review on predicting isotherm parameters from molecular features would cite as background on parameter estimation methodology.
